text.tspan: Every ratio on this sheet is computed from the two hex values beside it, not asserted. Body text needs 4.5 to 1 against its background; an accent under 3 to 1
can be a fill but not a hairline or a word. The label colour shown on each button is whichever of black or white actually passes on that accent.
